content.headline: No women on the stage
content.body: In Shakespeare's lifetime every female role, Juliet included, was played by a boy. Women first acted on England's public stage in the 1660s.

content.headline: A penny to stand
content.body: A penny bought standing room in the open yard, among the groundlings.
